"""Summaries of structured log records for the nightly digest."""


def parse_record(line):
    ts, level, service, message = line.split(" ", 3)
    return {"ts": ts, "level": level, "service": service, "message": message}


def summarize_errors(records):
    matching = [r for r in records if r["level"] == "ERROR"]
    if not matching:
        return "no ERROR records"
    by_service = {}
    for record in matching:
        by_service.setdefault(record["service"], []).append(record)
    lines = [f"{len(matching)} ERROR records"]
    for service in sorted(by_service):
        entries = by_service[service]
        latest = max(entry["ts"] for entry in entries)
        lines.append(f"  {service}: {len(entries)} (latest {latest})")
        if len(entries) > 3:
            lines.append(f"    first message: {entries[0]['message']}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def summarize_warnings(records):
    matching = [r for r in records if r["level"] == "WARNING"]
    if not matching:
        return "no WARNING records"
    by_service = {}
    for record in matching:
        by_service.setdefault(record["service"], []).append(record)
    lines = [f"{len(matching)} WARNING records"]
    for service in sorted(by_service):
        entries = by_service[service]
        latest = max(entry["ts"] for entry in entries)
        lines.append(f"  {service}: {len(entries)} (latest {latest})")
        if len(entries) > 3:
            lines.append(f"    first message: {entries[0]['message']}")
    return "\n".join(lines)
